::: {#def-transfer-learning}

#### Transfer learning

**Transfer learning** uses what a network learned on one task to start learning another task,
usually one with far fewer labelled examples
[@goodfellow2016deep, section 15.2].
One common form keeps the early layers of a network trained on the first task,
and trains a new last layer for the second.
Networks trained on ImageNet are often reused this way:
their first layers find edge-like patterns that are useful for many kinds of images
[@yosinski2014transferable].

:::
